## Problem

What are you trying to do that EvolvRoute doesn't support well today? Describe the use case,
not just the feature.

## Proposed behavior

What you'd like EvolvRoute to do. If it's a new lane, the routing policy, or the learning
loop, say which part.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've worked around this, or other designs you weighed.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, examples, or how this fits the roadmap in the README.
